BiblicalUsage: Liqchîy belongs to Likchi, an Israelite, and the Bible does not let it pass unnamed. In 1 Chronicles 7:19, "Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Likhi is named once among the sons of Shemidah, and that is enough — God keeps the families of Manasseh in the record.
